epic: Make the integration/E2E gate mandatory when a change spans >=3 architectural layers

stories.title: Make the integration/E2E gate mandatory when a change spans >=3 architectural la
stories.description: build-verify Gate 4 runs the integration suite when a command exists, but never treats it as mandatory based on how many architectural layers the change touches. Promote it to a blocking gate for cross-layer changes.
